_description: Power Sequencing Test Configuration — SENSOR Board
_objective: Verify that all SENSOR board power rails ramp in the correct order and reach 90% of their nominal voltage within the specified timing windows after the 5 V input supply is applied.
_instructions: Edit values below instead of modifying the Python code. Re-run the test to pick up changes.

_procedure.config_1: Connect Ch1→3V3 (trigger), Ch2→VDD_IO, Ch3→VDD_PLL, Ch4→VDD. Power on PSU to 5V, capture screenshot, record 90% crossing times. T=0 when 3.3V rail begins rising.
_procedure.config_2: Move probes: Ch1→VAA (trigger), Ch2→VAA_PIX, Ch3→VAA_PIX_BST, Ch4→VDD (reference). Re-run power cycle, capture screenshot. T=0 when VAA begins rising.

instrument_addresses._note: VISA address strings. scope: null triggers auto-detection.

output_dir._note: Base folder for results. A timestamped sub-folder is created automatically for each run.

psu_settings._note: PSU channel and voltage for DUT 5 V input supply.

scope_settings._note: Shared settings applied to both capture configurations. Trigger fires on the rising edge of Ch1 at 20% of that channel's nominal voltage.

scope_config_1._note: Digital rails capture. Ch1 (3V3) is the trigger reference — T=0 is when 3.3V begins rising.

1.name: 3V3
1._note: 3.3V buck output. Trigger channel — scope triggers on its rising edge.

2.name: VDD_IO
2._note: 1.8V LDO output supplying SENSOR IO rails.

scope_config_2._note: Analog rails capture. Ch1 (VAA) is the trigger reference — T=0 is when VAA begins rising.

1.name: VAA
1._note: 2.8V low-noise LDO supplying XGS45K analog supply. Trigger channel.

2.name: VAA_PIX
2._note: 3.0V low-noise LDO supplying XGS45K pixel array.

3.name: VAA_PIX_BST
3._note: 3.0V low-noise LDO supplying pixel array boost rail.

4.name: VDD
4._note: 1.2V digital core supply (VDD) — included as a reference between captures.

rail_timing_limits._note: Maximum allowed time (ms) for each rail to reach 90% of nominal. T=0 is defined per-capture-config (see scope_config_1 and scope_config_2 trigger_channel notes). Adjust limits after first test run to reflect actual hardware sequencing.

3V3._note: Trigger reference rail for Config 1. Must be the fastest.

VDD_IO._note: LDO output enabled after 3.3V rises. Measured from 3.3V T=0.

VDD_PLL._note: LDO output enabled after 3.6V rises. Measured from 3.3V T=0.

VDD._note: LDO output. Appears in both configs — limit applies in each.

VAA._note: Trigger reference rail for Config 2. T=0 reference for this capture.

VAA_PIX._note: LDO enabled after VAA rises. Measured from VAA T=0.

VAA_PIX_BST._note: LDO enabled after VAA rises. Measured from VAA T=0.
